summary: I fixed a section-ordering bug in port-recipe.md by renumbering Doc map to ## 5 and Verify to ## 6 so the walkthrough reads cleanly 1-6. Next I made the identity tree relocatable, converting kernel/{chat,goals,mem} symlinks from absolute host paths to relative targets and verifying they resolve. I then audited for remaining host paths and found one dead pointer in skills/.skillsrc (SKILLS_REMOTES to a nonexistent ~/.skills/core-skills); I confirmed nothing consumes it, so I'm treating it as removable.
